response.justification: This candidate possesses exceptional technical depth with 20+ years of software development experience and demonstrated teaching ability through workshops and mentoring initiatives. However, they lack the critical people management experience that is explicitly listed as a minimum requirement (2 years). The resume contains no evidence of managing direct reports, conducting performance reviews, setting team objectives, or leading organizational initiatives—all core responsibilities of this management role. While their technical foundation is strong, they are not ready for a mid-to-senior people leadership position without first gaining hands-on management experience.
strengths: Extensive 20+ years of software development experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems with demonstrated technical expertise
Strong track record of teaching and knowledge-sharing through workshops, multi-module courses, and organizing code kata/refactoring sessions, indicating ability to develop others
Recent hands-on experience with developer tooling including CI/CD infrastructure, testing frameworks (Fluent-Asserts, Trial), and current work on MCP code generators
concerns: Complete absence of people management experience; resume shows no evidence of managing direct reports, conducting 1-on-1s, or performance reviews—a stated minimum requirement

Limited demonstrated technical leadership; staff titles appear to be senior individual contributor roles without clear evidence of team leadership, architectural decision-making, or organizational influence

Developer tools experience is not primary career focus; expertise centers on general software development rather than deep specialization in compilers, build systems, and test automation infrastructure

key_factors.factor: Strong technical depth and teaching ability
